decisions.normalized_observation: 155-mm activity progressed, but the Q4 milestone cannot be resolved without guessing scope or quarter binding.
decisions.timing_interpretation: The Q4 commitment is ambiguous as to the exact fiscal/calendar quarter in the frozen card, and later evidence distinguishes intermediate supplies from a complete 155-mm round. The selected passages do not unambiguously establish either full achievement or non-achievement of the exact frozen commercial-activity milestone.

decisions.normalized_observation: No explicit closed full-year presales actual resolves the INR210 billion target.
decisions.timing_interpretation: The source-date full-year horizon is not uniquely bound in the frozen card, and selected later evidence reports Q4 presales rather than an explicit full-year presales total against INR210 billion.

decisions.normalized_observation: The five-year development-business gross-margin commitment remains unresolved.
decisions.timing_interpretation: The approximately 45% gross-margin target sits within a five-year development plan from 2025-03-27. The plan horizon remains open and later portfolio-margin commentary is interim.

decisions.normalized_observation: Net debt/EBITDA exceeded the promised 1.5x ceiling, reaching 1.66x.
decisions.timing_interpretation: The frozen commitment is to keep peak net debt to EBITDA at or below about 1.5x across the cycle. Exchange evidence published 2026-05-06 explicitly reports 1.66x as of 2026-03-31, which breaches the maintenance ceiling and therefore falsifies the commitment.

decisions.normalized_observation: A320 C-check certification cannot be resolved from the selected evidence and ambiguous year binding.
decisions.timing_interpretation: The wording 'by the end of the year' from 2025-05-22 is ambiguous between fiscal and calendar year, and the selected later evidence contains no explicit A320 C-check certification completion outcome.

decisions.normalized_observation: The Norton India launch had not occurred by the April 2026 deadline and remained forthcoming in May 2026.
decisions.timing_interpretation: The frozen deadline is 2026-04-30. Exchange evidence published 2026-05-19, after that deadline, still says more details will be provided closer to the launch and that some Norton models will be available in India, explicitly placing the launch after the promised April window.

decisions.normalized_observation: No explicit closed full-year ETR resolves the marginally-above-26% expectation.
decisions.timing_interpretation: The 2024-10-29 'full-year' horizon is not uniquely bound in the frozen card and selected later evidence does not explicitly provide the matching completed full-year effective tax rate.

decisions.normalized_observation: Debt declined and management reiterated the FY27 debt-free ambition, but the exact FY26 percentage target is not evidenced.
decisions.timing_interpretation: The FY26 debt-reduction component has matured, but selected later evidence gives an absolute INR164 crore reduction rather than the promised 35%-40% percentage, while the separate almost-debt-free FY27 endpoint remains open. The composite target cannot be resolved.

decisions.normalized_observation: The December 2026 production milestone remains open.
decisions.timing_interpretation: The explicit production go-live deadline is 2026-12-31, after the immutable source cutoff. The commitment is not yet mature.

decisions.normalized_observation: The USD120 million export target cannot be resolved without guessing the year binding.
decisions.timing_interpretation: The 'current year' horizon from 2025-05-29 is ambiguous between calendar and fiscal year, and selected evidence does not explicitly report a completed matching export total of about USD120 million.

decisions.normalized_observation: The five-year market-relative growth target remains unresolved.
decisions.timing_interpretation: The target is to sustain growth above 1.5x market growth over five years from 2025-01-29. The five-year horizon remains open and interim observations cannot close it.

decisions.normalized_observation: Xpulse 210 launched within six months of the commitment.
decisions.timing_interpretation: Six months from the 2024-11-21 source runs through 2025-05-21. Exchange evidence published 2025-05-19 explicitly calls Xpulse 210 one of the company's latest launches and reports a very good response, establishing launch within the promised six-month horizon.

decisions.normalized_observation: FY27 bed additions are in progress but the annual >400-bed target is not yet mature.
decisions.timing_interpretation: The commitment is for more than 400 added beds in FY27. FY27 had not closed by the source cutoff; the approximately 100 operational beds reported in an interim quarter are progress only.

decisions.normalized_observation: The reported margin exceeded the guidance band, but favorable-overshoot treatment was not frozen in H003-O001.
decisions.timing_interpretation: Later evidence reports a full-period margin of 29.7% and explicitly says it was significantly higher than the 27%-28% guidance. The frozen outcome rule does not specify whether a favorable overshoot beyond an explicit target_max should be classified MET, so the semantic result is fail-closed to UNRESOLVED rather than introducing post-outcome directionality logic.

decisions.normalized_observation: The conditional alumina-margin target is not yet measurable.
decisions.timing_interpretation: The INR500-600 crore margin outcome is conditional on a planned two-lakh-ton alumina production increase. The selected evidence does not establish that the production increase occurred and then quantify the associated realized margin contribution.

decisions.normalized_observation: The specific transmission-project commissioning outcome is not present in the selected evidence.
decisions.timing_interpretation: The three-to-five-month commissioning window from 2026-01-27 has matured, but selected later evidence does not explicitly state the commissioning status of the exact Khavda Phase III/Halvad and WRSR projects.
